header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
body: None present on behalf of the petitioners nor any intimation is received. This petition was filed in the year 2020 and lastly fixed on 15.07.2026, on that date no one appeared on behalf of the petitioners, therefore, notice was issued to the petitioners through learned District Judge, Sanghar, inspite of that position is same. It appears that petitioners have lost interest in the matter. Accordingly, this petition is dismissed for non-prosecution.
